title: Crispy Baked Marinated Tofu
ingredients: 4 tbsp (1/4 cup) cornstarch or arrowroot powder
4 tbsp (1/4 cup) sesame oil (or olive oil)
4 tbsp (1/4 cup) rice vinegar (or lime juice)
instructions: Press the tofu: Wrap the tofu blocks in clean kitchen towels or paper towels. Set cutting boards or heavy skillets on top for 20 minutes to press out excess liquid. Cut all blocks into 3/4-inch cubes.

Whisk marinade and soak: In a large bowl (or two medium bowls), whisk together the soy sauce, sesame oil, maple syrup, rice vinegar, garlic powder, ground ginger, and optional sriracha. Add the tofu cubes, tossing gently to coat. Let soak at room temperature for 20 to 30 minutes.

Toss with cornstarch: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Line 2 to 3 large rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper. Scoop the tofu out of the marinade, leaving behind excess liquid. Sprinkle the cornstarch over the cubes and toss gently until lightly and evenly coated.

Bake without overcrowding: Spread the tofu across the baking sheets in a single layer, ensuring the cubes do not touch. Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 25 to 30 minutes, flipping the cubes and swapping rack positions halfway through (at ~15 minutes), until golden brown and crispy on the edges.
notes: Yields ~1,320g cooked (~440g per block). Serving is ~110g cooked (~1 cup / 1/3 block). Nutrition is per serving; also provides ~25% DV calcium and ~15% DV iron. Whole batch: 2,640 kcal, 204g protein, 144g fat (21.6g saturated), 132g carbohydrates, 24g fiber, 48g sugar, 8,160mg sodium. Garlic powder and ground ginger replace 8 fresh cloves and 4 tsp fresh grated ginger.
